description: An upstream release bump is a scripted, reviewable operation.
steps: Pull the new upstream SHA into upstream/video-shotcraft
Run: python platform/ingest/run.py
Run: python platform/wiki/build_wiki.py
Review git diff of wiki/index.json and confirm only the expected counts and new cards changed
Verify the new SHA is recorded in source_repo.head_sha
Verify no row lost its source_file_id, so the change is traceable
verified_by: platform/bump_upstream.py --check reports the pinned SHA 5ddbf52 and 'up to date' against origin. The script is a diff gate, not 'git pull': it snapshots counts + card slugs + provenance before, fetches, rebuilds, and refuses to finish unless every change is in the allowlist. A count that goes DOWN, a card that disappears or is renamed, a source_file that loses its sha256, or any movement in the technique count all block the bump and are reported, because those mean the corpus changed shape and the parser needs updating too. The database is restored from backup on any gate failure.
